messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Subject: Interim band bridge and lateral transfers — anchoring proposal

Team — attaching the first pass of the interim band bridge and the list of proposed lateral transfers from Platform -> Serving. The goal is to close loop on anchoring decisions before the 12/1 payroll cutoff. Key notes: 

- Proposed 6 transfers; 3 require manager-level approvals + comp uplift requests. See sheet 'Transfers' tab.
- We're recommending temporary anchoring in Band 4A for senior ICs moving across functions, with a 6-month review to confirm slotting.
- Need HR signoff on comp exceptions and a legal quick-scan for client-facing titles (Greenfield alignment).

Action items for today: 
1) Laura: validate promotion history for the three affected ICs and confirm any outstanding PIP/review notes.
2) Olga & Rishi: advise on comp uplift budget and whether we can route as one-off exceptions.
3) Mateo & Marissa: assemble comms for the impacted individuals and set 1:1s.

Attachments: 20261127-band-proposals.xlsx (sheet tabs: Transfers, Rationale, Budget); 20261127-transfer-justifications.pdf

Thanks — sending high level to keep momentum before next week's calibration call.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, People Ops (EM/Calibration)

Subject: Re: Interim band bridge and lateral transfers — anchoring proposal

Thanks Marissa — reviewed the spreadsheet. A few clarifying points and flags: 

- One candidate (A. Chen) has a live performance conversation from 7/2026 flagged in the file; we need to exclude them from any automatic uplift until we complete a short remediation plan.
- For two client-facing titles moving to Greenfield Health support, Greenfield has historically required title parity; Ops asked for explicit language in the job packet. That will affect the comp band.
- Please make sure we handle communications as 'private HR update' — do not include managers outside the immediate chain.

I added comments in Transfers tab and uploaded a short one-pager with manager talking points. Also attached a redlines PDF for the title changes.

Attachments referenced in-line: 20261127-transfer-justifications.pdf; uploaded talking_points_1127.docx to the Drive link.

Hi Marissa/Mateo — thanks for the heads-up and the packet. Greenfield is generally supportive of the transfers but we have two asks: 

1) Title parity: if an engineer moves into a client-facing integration role, we need title alignment to match our vendor roster.
2) Comp transparency: we will need confirmation of OTE/total comp for any individual we onboard as a named vendor; exceptions must be approved by our procurement lead.

We can sign a simple non-disclosure around the personnel details if that helps with the private comms. I'm copying our HR ops address to make sure procurement sees this thread.

— Sarah Green
Head of Integrations
Greenfield Health
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, hr-ops@greenfieldhealth.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interim band bridge and lateral transfers — anchoring proposal

Team — good convergence here. Summary of decisions from the interim sync and next steps: 

1) Anchor approach: temporary Band 4A anchoring approved for 3 senior IC transfers; 6-month review to validate slotting and performance.
2) Exclusion: A. Chen excluded pending remediation plan — Laura will confirm timeline by 12/6.
3) Title parity & external ask: we'll provide Greenfield with proposed titles and total comp ranges per person; procurement clearance required before start date.
4) Comp exceptions: Olga & Rishi to confirm whether we can route the three uplifts as 'one-off market adjustments' under existing comp reserve. If not, we'll need a Quick Exec approval (I can take to the Execs Monday).
5) Comms: Marissa & I will own manager + individual comms; Laura will provide the talking points.

Attachments: 20261129-final-anchor-commit.csv (finalized anchors for payroll ingestion).

Please confirm you see this as the final set and I'll open HR-TICKET-48291 and push to HROps (link above). If Olga/Rishi can't clear the uplift by COB Monday I'll escalate to execs.

Thanks — Mateo
